title: NoUnicode
description: A customizable Minecraft chat filter that restricts players to only using characters from a configurable whitelist, preventing Unicode spam and emoji flooding while maintaining clean, readable chat.
body:
# NoUnicode

A simple Minecraft plugin that blocks players from using Unicode characters, emojis, and special symbols in chat. Only allows standard keyboard characters (A-Z, 0-9, and basic symbols).

## What it does:
- Blocks Unicode characters and emojis in chat messages
- Shows players which characters were blocked
- Allows server admins to customize which characters are allowed
- Bypass permission for staff members

## How it works:
- Players without bypass permission can only use characters from `allowed-characters.txt`
- Blocked messages show helpful error messages
- Admins can reload settings with `/nounicode reload`

## Perfect for:
- Preventing emoji/Unicode spam
- Keeping chat clean and readable
- Servers that want English-only chat

**Requirements:** Paper 1.21+
